gloss: many times; repeatedly; over and over

definitions.gloss: many times; repeatedly; over and over again
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens or is done numerous times. Emphasizes repetition, often implying persistence or frustration.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧でしょう。
examples.english: I've told you many times, haven't I?

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After practicing over and over, I finally got it.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何度|なんど}も⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I've seen that movie many times, but every time I discover something new.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧ (how many times) and the particle ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even, also), giving the sense of "as many times as..." — i.e., many times. One of the most common expressions for describing repetition in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Extremely common in both spoken and written Japanese. Can express positive persistence ({何度|なんど}も⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ — tried many times) or exasperation ({何度|なんど}も⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧ — I've said it many times). The related expression ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ means "no matter how many times" and is more emphatically unlimited.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何度|なんど}も⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ — to repeat over and over
- {何度|なんど}も⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ — to try many times
- {何度|なんど}も⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ — to check repeatedly
- {何度|なんど}も{何度|なんど}も — again and again and again (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — many times (interchangeable, slightly more casual)
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧ — repeatedly (more formal, often written)
- {度々|たびたび} — frequently, often (more formal, polite nuance)
